bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Oxford's League One depth faces Cheltenham's confirmed wholesale cup rotation.

spf.comment: Oxford's third-tier home depth against Steve Cotterill's rotated Cheltenham XI supports a 2:1 home win as primary, while covering the 2:2 draw accounts for Aaron Ramsey's cup rotation and both teams' recurring 2:2 EFL Trophy group results.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 4.50 combined Poisson lambda total, 73.8% BTTS baseline, Cheltenham's 3.0 goals conceded per game, and three consecutive 2:2 EFL Trophy matches across both clubs.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Oxford's Kassam Stadium edge over a makeshift Cheltenham defence, while 2:2 captures the exact scoreline recorded in all three EFL Trophy matches played by these teams this season.

goals.comment: Three and four total goals represent the premier high-event scoring bands (16.9% and 19.0% model probability) when bilateral defensive rotation meets open cup transitions.

bqc.comment: Oxford led 1:0 at half-time in both recent home wins over Cheltenham to anchor Win-Win, while Win-Draw covers second-half defensive lapses from a rotated Oxford backline.
